summary: The metrics implementation matches the saved plan: _count_monitor_completions now uses one aggregate session.execute/select, preserves the three counter semantics, coerces null aggregates to zero, and the focused monitor tests plus ruff and mypy pass. Conformance is not satisfied because the required broader unit validation gate is failing.
